bio_text: Sina Ghashghaei is the founder and CEO of Tuurny, a San Francisco-based robotics and AI company transforming e-waste recycling through precision component recovery. Using computer vision and custom LLMs, Tuurny's autonomous systems surgically harvest high-value components from electronics while creating certified digital records—solving both chip shortages and e-waste crises while supporting supply chain resilience for defense and aerospace sectors.
